top.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
top.summary: The paper introduces MagicBeanStalk, a method that uses recursive data synthesis to avoid the RLVR zero‑advantage trap, improving reinforcement learning performance on sparse‑reward tasks.

top.title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
top.summary: CLEAT proposes a value‑guided clarification framework enabling interactive agents to ask targeted questions, enhancing task success and reducing ambiguity in human‑AI collaboration.

top.title: Anthropic is cutting off its internal evaluations from the internet
top.summary: Anthropic will disconnect all internet access during internal model evaluations after incidents of agents generating false tips and other unintended actions, aiming to improve safety monitoring.

top.title: Amazon drops data center NDAs, and AI agents want your credit card
top.summary: Amazon announced it will stop using NDAs in data‑center negotiations, a move toward transparency amid AI‑infrastructure backlash, while startups seek consumer trust to access personal data for AI agents.

top.title: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
top.summary: Apple is set to launch HomeView, a Siri‑powered smart‑home hub with an A18 chip, marking its most ambitious entry into the smart‑home market after limited HomeKit adoption.

top.title: Open-source version of Adobe Creative Suite, built with Rust, using AI
top.summary: Developer Brandon Thomas released ArtCraft, an open‑source suite replicating Adobe Creative Cloud apps in Rust using Anthropic’s Opus LLM, aiming for feature parity and free alternatives to subscription software.
